description: Change notes of a score by id, up to 2,000 a call: pitch, at_beats, length_beats, velocity. Fields left out keep their values. Returns the new score_id (edit that one next).

at_beats.description: From the start of the region it sounds in, as score.get shows it

pitch.description: A MIDI number 0–127, decimals allowed (60.5 a quarter-tone above middle C), or a name such as C3 or F#4; C4 is 60, middle C

velocity.description: 1 to 127: how hard it is struck

name: score.set_notes

changed.description: What the edit added, removed or modified

at.description: Where an added or modified region now starts

beats.description: Beats from the start (a quarter note is 1)

frames.description: At the score fps, exact (45.5 is half way through frame 45); absent without fps

beats.description: Beats from the start (a quarter note is 1)

frames.description: At the score fps, exact (45.5 is half way through frame 45); absent without fps

part_id.description: The part a device, send or region is on (master for its devices)

parent.description: The version this edit started from

score_id.description: The new version: edit this one next (older ids stay valid)

title: Set notes
